theme: A wide-open day, with a couple of overdue bookings to close.
greeting: The calendar's nearly clear, Dan — a birthday reminder at 5 and otherwise open. The day's real weight is a pair of overdue travel bookings worth closing before they get harder and pricier.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out; a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk. Flagged in Todoist to book this week — it's 10 days past due.

needsAttention.title: Reschedule the girls' passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: With everyone back after the Sept 20 return, the four-kid passport appointment needs rebooking — the book-by date feeds the December trip decision. Its Todoist due date passed on Sept 21.

schedule.title: Julia's birthday
schedule.detail: A recurring reminder on your calendar

flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced a Senior VP of Global Public Policy role and similar openings — worth a glance given the search.

flagged.title: Amazon sign-in from Florida
flagged.detail: Amazon flagged a new iPhone sign-in near Florida this morning, which lines up with you; AbeBooks separately confirmed a password change you requested.

inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on a reply from you.
